name: STA237H1 — Correction Attribution (Sampling Distributions)
description: 'Sampling distribution of X̄ = histogram of data.' WRONG. Sampling distribution = distribution of X̄ across ALL possible samples of size n. A theoreti

steps.template_en: 'Sampling distribution of X̄ = histogram of data.' WRONG. Sampling distribution = distribution of X̄ across ALL possible samples of size n. A theoretical concept — we usually see ONE sample.
steps.template_zh: 'X̄的抽样分布=数据直方图。'错。抽样分布=所有可能样本中X̄的分布。理论概念——通常只看到一个样本。

steps.template_en: Population {1,3,5}, n=2 with replacement. Possible (1,1)→1, (1,3)→2, ..., (5,5)→5. Sampling distribution: P(1)=1/9, P(2)=2/9, ..., P(5)=1/9. E[X̄]=μ, Var(X̄)=σ²/n.
steps.template_zh: 总体{1,3,5}, n=2有放回。抽样分布：E[X̄]=μ, Var(X̄)=σ²/n。

steps.template_en: Sampling distribution: mean=μ (UNBIASED), variance=σ²/n (decreases with n). Normal data: X̄~N(μ,σ²/n). Non-normal: CLT → approx normal for large n. Enables inference.
steps.template_zh: X̄的抽样分布：均值=μ(无偏)，方差=σ²/n(随n减)。正态数据：X̄~N(μ,σ²/n)。非正态：CLT→大n近似正态。使推断可能。

steps.template_en: Standard error SE=σ/√n. Unknown σ → use S/√n. SE tells PRECISION: smaller SE → more precise. Doubling n reduces SE by only √2 — '√n law' of diminishing returns.
steps.template_zh: 标准误SE=σ/√n。σ未知→S/√n。SE告诉精度：更小SE→更精确。n翻倍SE仅降√2——'√n定律'边际递减。

steps.template_en: Population μ=100, σ=15, n=25: (1) Sampling distribution of X̄? (2) P(X̄>106)? (3) For SE=2, what n needed? (4) Sample: X̄=104. What can we infer about μ?

Sampling distribution is BRIDGE between probability and statistics. Probability: given population, likely samples? Statistics: given sample, what is population? CENTRAL concept in frequentist inference.
steps.template_zh: 抽样分布是连接概率和统计的桥梁。概率：给定总体，什么样本可能？统计：给定样本，总体是什么？频率学派推断的核心概念。
